snippet.title: Gears of War 3: Dust to Dust
snippet.description:
Get ready to return to Sera and "Finish It," in the epic finale to the Gears of War trilogy! Watch "Dust to Dust," the Gears of War 3 trailer and witness Brothers to the End!

ESRB Rating:  MATURE 17+ (Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Strong Language)
